prompt: A photorealistic street corner in 1928. A large hand-painted shop sign on a wooden facade reads, in flowing painted letters: "THE ORIGINAL BUBBLY ORANGE SODA", "COLD, CRISP, ALMOND-KISSED", "BOTTLED BY HENRY & SONS, 1928", with a painted orange slice and a splash of foam. Below the sign, a wooden crate holds glass bottles with small paper labels reading "BUBBLY ORANGE", a bicycle leans against the wall, and a paper sun hat sits on the crate. Morning light, cobblestones, a faint mist, 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptZh: 一个照片级真实的街角，时间设定在 1928 年。木质门面上挂着一块巨大的手绘商店招牌，上面用流畅的字体写着：“THE ORIGINAL BUBBLY ORANGE SODA”、“COLD, CRISP, ALMOND-KISSED”、“BOTTLED BY HENRY & SONS, 1928”，并绘有橙子切片和泡沫飞溅的图案。招牌下方，一个木箱里装着贴有“BUBBLY ORANGE”小纸标签的玻璃瓶，墙边靠着一辆自行车，木箱上放着一顶纸制遮阳帽。晨光，鹅卵石路面，淡淡的薄雾，2:3 纵横比。
